title: Visit History Share of the Ridgeline Installation Services Customer Reschedule Fee
content:
The visits recorded on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract set the job-history share of the customer reschedule fee. A contract on which only the installer has missed a visit earns goodwill; a contract on which only the customer side has caused a failed visit carries a repeat-disruption multiple.

## Job-history share

| What the contract's visit records show | Job-history share |
|---|---|
| an installer no-show visit, and no visit at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready | 0.5, the goodwill share |
| a visit at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready, and no installer no-show visit | 1.25, the repeat-disruption multiple |
| any other contract | 1 |

The customer reschedule fee is multiplied by the job-history share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the customer reschedule fee is rounded, the customer reschedule fee being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Records that decide the share

The visit lines of the contract, each recorded by the installer with its outcome: completed as scheduled, installer no-show, customer absent, or site not ready. Every recorded visit on the contract counts, whatever its kind (measure, installation or warranty service).

## Combinations

| Installer no-show visits | Customer-absent or site-not-ready visits | Share |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | none | 0.5 |
| none | one or more | 1.25 |
| one or more | one or more | 1 |
| none | none | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee of 150.00 before the share)

- The installer missed the first installation visit; every other visit went ahead: 150.00 multiplied by 0.5 is 75.00.
- The site was not ready at one installation visit; the installer never missed a visit: 150.00 multiplied by 1.25 is 187.50.
- One installer no-show and one customer-absent visit are both on record: the share is 1 and the fee stays 150.00.
